methods.lifecycleDefinition: preparationMs + transactionToValidatedPlaintextMs; includes input work, estimation and signing, excludes intentional barrier wait
methods.viewDefinition: viewToValidatedPlaintextMs after successful primary max, an already-ready retrieval without a new transaction
methods.estimand: exp(mean round-matched log(candidate/reference latency)), conditional on both observations succeeding
methods.bootstrap: Circular moving blocks separately within the original and continuation segments, preserving fixed observed segment sample counts and pairing
methods.ci: Pointwise 95% basic bootstrap CI on the log mean, exponentiated; not multiplicity-adjusted
methods.p: min(1, 2*(min(count(centeredReplicate >= observed), count(centeredReplicate <= observed))+1)/(B+1)); centeredReplicate = bootstrapMean - observedMean
methods.multiplicity: Holm step-down jointly over all 42 tests: 6 operations * 3 platform pairs * 2 widths, plus 3 already-ready view pairs * 2 widths
methods.scope: Exploratory conditional public-network comparisons. Approximate within-segment stationarity and sufficiently weak short-range dependence are assumed. Success selection and network confounding remain. No equivalence, causal slowdown or isolated compute claim follows.
